checkpoints.day10_new_checkpoints_description: 10 Sleep interaction (M_B, M_AB x 5 seeds) + already-counted-elsewhere reproduction reloads (no new checkpoints from pure reproduction runs, only from the new interaction experiment)

interaction_limitation.note: One clean interaction experiment (Sleep-EDF EEG x EOG x Resp) was audited, predeclared, run, and honestly analyzed (result: approximately_additive_or_unresolved - no forced synergy claim). This materially addresses the interaction-evidence gap for one specific candidate pair on one target, but does NOT establish global sensor-interaction knowledge or a globally minimal sensor subset. Two other candidates (PPG-DaLiA IMU x EDA/TEMP, PTT second-site x IMU) remain explicitly deferred, not resolved. docs/SENSOR_INTERACTION_LIMITATION.md's overall limitation therefore remains open in general, materially addressed in this one instance.

scientific_contract.note: No canonical scientific value was changed by Day 10 reproduction (everything matched exactly or within documented float32 tolerance). The interaction result is new evidence, reported in its own dedicated artifacts (results/sleep_edf_interaction_resp_day10.json, docs/INTERACTION_EXPERIMENT_RESULTS_DAY10.md) rather than folded into the sensor marginal-value contract, since it answers a structurally different question (interaction, not marginal value) - no version churn was needed.

claims_governance.note: PPG-DaLiA IMU necessity, PTT second-site global uselessness, Sleep independent-dataset replication, Sleep EOG necessity, global minimal architecture, Digital Twin validation, and astronaut/spaceflight validation were NOT claimed or upgraded this sprint, per the explicit Day-10 prohibition.

remaining_science_blockers.description: Interaction evidence exists for only one of three audited candidate pairs; the other two (PPG-DaLiA EDA/TEMP, PTT IMU) remain unresolved by design (deferred, not attempted this sprint).
N3 regression in the secondary Sleep-EDF cohort is verified/quantified but its underlying cause (why aligned EOG increases N2->N3 false positives) is not investigated - descriptive only, as required.

This repo's core.autocrlf=true creates a real but now-understood-and-fixed checkout-encoding trap for any future frozen-content SHA256 guard; worth a one-line note in onboarding docs for any new contributor cloning on Windows.
